messages:
Maria S.: Hey team — supporting AcmeBank POC (enterprise banking). Customer requirements: EU data residency, SSO, handling PII, and a 6–8 week pilot. They asked for deployment recommendation (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) and rough pricing delta. Can we align async?

Leo T.: Quick Qs — expected steady QPS and p95 latency target? Also will they feed sensitive documents or just structured fields?

Maria S.: They will send transaction logs + customer messages (redacted?), plus occasional attachments. Ballpark: 30–70 reqs/sec initially, spikey during batch jobs. Want p95 < 300ms.

Anjali P.: For 30–70 rps with p95 <300ms, Dedicated (reserved pool) in eu-west-1 is usually best. Hosted could work but costs and throughput variability may hit them. Private only if legal requires data never leave customer's VPC.

Anjali P.: Also need prompt/profile details — average prompt tokens? If long contexts (1k+ tokens) that changes kernel choice and latency.

Maria S.: Typical prompts ~300 tokens, some threads up to 1.2k.

Anjali P.: Ok — runtime notes: recommend Dedicated with KV/prefix cache enabled, 1x reserved pool sized for 80 rps sustained with 2x burst. Autoscale with burst to Hosted fallback in eu-west if capacity exhausted. Quantization profile: int8 recommended for cost.

Dave R.: Security checklist: we need customer SQ answers for encryption at rest, BYOK/KMS, logging/audit retention, tenancy isolation, and SOC2/ISO certs. If they require on-prem or no egress, mark as Private. Send the questionnaire to security@redwood.ai.

Maria S.: I will upload the SQ to the shared drive: https://redwood.share/AcmeBank-SQ — pinging now.

Sam K.: Suggested POC success criteria (proposal):
- Functional: extraction accuracy >= 95% on provided entity set (transactions/amounts, vendor, category)
- Performance: p95 latency <= 250ms for 300-token prompts, sustained throughput >= 50 rps
- Reliability: <1% error rate over 24h stress run
- Ops: rollout path (canary -> full) and cost delta estimate documented

Sam K.: Example eval prompt set (small):
```
Q1: "Extract payee and amount from: \"Paid Acme Corp invoice #12345 $4,200.00 via ACH\""
Q2: "Categorize transaction: \"TST*NETFLIX.COM 15.99\""
```
Target: exact match extraction for entities.

Rachel C.: Proposed timeline (6 weeks):
Week 1: security signoff + environment setup (Dedicated prov + SSO)
Week 2: ingest sample data, build prompt library
Week 3: run baseline evals (3 models/quant profiles)
Week 4: optimize batching/caching, rerun evals
Week 5: customer QA + edge-case tests
Week 6: final demo + handoff + draft pricing/commit proposal

Rachel C.: Pricing ballpark to give customer now: Hosted estimate (baseline): ~$0.015 per 1k tokens for gen + variable infra. Dedicated: committed monthly pool ~ $12k–25k/month depending on pool sizing and region. Private (VPC/on-prem): enterprise licensing + infra (~$50k+ setup). These are estimates — sales to confirm with finance for exacts.

Leo T.: My recommendation summary for the customer: "Start Dedicated in eu-west-1 with 3-month reserved pool sized for 80 rps, enable autoscale/burst to Hosted within eu-west for spikes. If legal prohibits cross-tenant data flow, move to Private and expect onboarding lead time + infra cost."

Dave R.: I'll review the uploaded SQ tonight. If they ask for HSM/BYOK we can support KMS integrations; HSM needs legal/SLA addendum. Also confirm retention windows.

Maria S.: Thanks — I'll ask AcmeBank to complete the SQ and share expected dataset size + retention policy. Also will confirm whether attachments contain full PDFs (may require OCR).

Anjali P.: Note for onboarding: provisioning Dedicated pool in eu-west-1 typically ~48–72 hours once order is signed. Private on-prem timeline is longer (4–8 weeks).

deploy-bot: FYI — Dedicated pool avail in eu-west-1: lead time 48h, current capacity moderate.

Maria S.: Next steps: 1) I collect SQ and dataset sample (by Tue) 2) Leo & Anjali to draft POC config + rough cost estimate (by Wed) 3) Dave to confirm security blocker list (by Thu) — is that doable?

Leo T.: Yup — I'll post a draft config in #sales later today.

Anjali P.: Can do. I'll include quantization and cache settings.

Dave R.: I'll send initial blocker list after SQ review.

Rachel C.: I'll prepare the 6-week runbook and metrics dashboard template.

Maria S.: Perfect. If we agree, I'll share this thread with the customer as the internal plan. :thumbsup:

Leo T.: :thumbsup:

Anjali P.: :thumbsup:
